config.fixed_trace: Both covariance families normalised to empirical training trace before synthesis; quotient derivatives included.
config.radius_baseline: Freeze likelihood-fitted covariance; select radius multiplier times sqrt(d) using the same validation empirical regret; evaluate only after selection.
config.primary_relationship: Supplementary mechanism analysis; does not replace the frozen decision_study primary endpoint.
config.question: Do estimator differences persist when moment scale is fixed or radius tuning is allowed?

primary_decision_config.mean_assumption: known_zero_mean; nondegenerate random initial state included in disturbance trajectory
primary_decision_config.plant_assumption: known dynamics; material-dependent synthetic coupled thermal deviation model
primary_decision_config.primary_endpoint: paired decision_shrinkage minus likelihood_shrinkage expected true noncausal-oracle regret, dr_regret controller, reported separately for every sample size and shift
negative_controls: different absolutely continuous nominal distributions with identical second moments produce identical controller objective
same adaptive interval updates with GP versus constant versus directly measured nominal gain
primary_decision_config.interpretation: No guaranteed estimator improvement. Radius is a design parameter, not an asserted finite-sample confidence set. Learned-dynamics uncertainty is not included in the known-dynamics theorem.
